approvers: Owner decides alone; glazing subcontractor and developer would need to agree who pays
reason: We have never bought this and I buy from people I have worked with for years. No Maltese reference job, and the coating maker excludes damage to coated glass and frames, so I would be relying on a €2,500 cap from a supplier with no track record.
objection: If the coating marks the frame or the coated glass when it comes off, who pays? The manufacturer excludes it, and a €2,500 cap from a new company does not cover a block's worth of glazing.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape from the hardware store, have the crew clean the glass at handover, and let the glazing subcontractor deal with any scratches.
would_change_my_mind: A Maltese reference job I can visit, plus written confirmation from the coating maker that it is compatible with our glass coating and frame finish, with liability cover that is not capped at €2,500.
